strings: m_c insists to r_c0 that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/have/has} been chosen by StarClan to herald the end of the world - a terrifying prospect, but completely untrue.
m_c is struggling to differentiate hallucinations and delusions from reality.
Just when m_c feels confident in managing {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} thunderous spirit symptoms, they escalate rapidly. m_c is experiencing a psychotic episode.
m_c is completely convinced that every cat in the Clan has it out for {PRONOUN/m_c/object}, despite all evidence to the contrary.
